parsed.explanation: Tier-1 exposure: a birth-certificate facility rule reaches all state buildings, schools, universities and prisons, enforced within days (ID checks at capitol restrooms, escalated school-district investigation), with no working remedy — no statewide discrimination law and a hate-crime statute excluding gender identity. The parent regime adds entry exposure: document/sex discrepancies can trigger refusal or fraud findings, and X markers are barred. The state sits in a July 2026 top 'Do Not Travel' tier, official hostility is sustained, and custody shows documented care denial affirmed on appeal. Mitigating: no trans-specific offence, enforcement episodes are few and guidance unclear, hotels/private premises show no documented exclusion, and recorded killings (7.6/100k trans women/yr) are near background violence, not organised targeting. Friction and hostile climate are real but secondary to the unremedied universal facility rule.
